defect: The fix rewrites the change's new macro_func constructions (temporary moved into make_unique, query node moved out of the temporary SelectStatement instead of Copy()) to repair an unspecified OSX regression.
reason: The touched lines are the change's own, but the old and new code are semantically equivalent apart from the restored Copy(), and neither the repository nor the fix shows what failed on OSX.

defect: The fix repairs the infinite loop of RegexFindAll on empty matches and the strlen-based StringPiece overread; the change only added numeric casts.
reason: Both repaired defects (position advance and StringPiece(input) without length) existed before this cast-only change.

defect: The fix restores DUCKDB_INSTALL_LIB instead of the hard-coded developer dylib path the change put into the ADBC test.
reason: Both the change and the fix touch only test code, which the instructions count as a test change, not a product defect.

defect: The fix moves dependency extraction for defaults and CHECK constraints from the physical planner to binding so WAL replay (force-restart) also registers them.
reason: Extracting dependencies at plan time was the existing pattern for defaults; the change only extended it to CHECK constraints, which had no dependencies registered at all before, so the restart gap was pre-existing.

defect: WKBColumnWriterState was declared with ParquetCastOperator while WKBColumnWriter uses ParquetStringOperator, so StandardColumnWriter casts the state to a different template instantiation (failed dynamic cast check / type punning).
reason: The changed base-class line introduced the operator mismatch, which is visible next to the unchanged writer declaration, and the fix restores ParquetStringOperator.

defect: The fix moves the JSON round-trip into a test that is skipped when the json extension is not loaded.
reason: The change and the fix only touch a unit test, which the instructions treat as a test change.

defect: The fix changes root->agg_distinct to root.agg_distinct after a merge with master, where the transformer moved from pointers to references.
reason: root was a pointer when the change was written, so the line compiled; the breakage came from the concurrent refactor merged in 2e645f8.

defect: The fix factors sinking into SinkDataChunk, drops the Resize calls and scans the payload with payload_types instead of all_types plus Split, fixing VARCHAR/nested list_sort failures.
reason: The repaired scan and Resize code existed before the change (it was only re-indented under the new data_to_sort guard), and the failing cases were already documented as open bugs.

defect: Deserialize reads the new export_state field with ReadRequired, so FunctionExpressions serialized before this field existed fail to deserialize.
reason: The change added the required read of a newly added field, and the fix replaces it with ReadField<bool>(false) for backward compatibility.

defect: The new fast path checks the source validity instead of the result validity, so lists with a length mismatch are cast over child_count elements, and the slow path copies and casts array_size elements of mismatched lists, overwriting the NULL result.
reason: Both the fast-path condition and the slow-path loop were written by this change, and the fix switches to the result validity and skips rows already marked NULL.

defect: The rewritten Finalize drops the FunctionData* parameter the aggregate executor passes (compile failure), and Combine sets is_set unconditionally so empty states yield a value instead of NULL.
reason: The fix restores the FunctionData* signature and makes Combine respect source/target is_set, both on lines this change wrote.

defect: The fix makes current_schema() and current_schemas() return the configured search path instead of the hard-coded DEFAULT_SCHEMA.
reason: The search path only became configurable later (#2317), so the hard-coded value was correct when written; the fix adapts to a new feature.

defect: The new loop over loaded extensions appends an extra result for every extension already seen in the install directory, with no extension_name and an UNKNOWN or STATICALLY_LOADED tag, producing bogus rows.
reason: The block was added by this change and the fix removes it as 'bogus lines in extension update result'.

defect: The fix makes a first row of NULLs count as a header again when the column types are not all VARCHAR.
reason: Treating a NULL first row as no header was introduced two commits earlier (9c45b1f); this change kept that behaviour while merging it with the all_varchar condition.

defect: The fix adds const qualifiers in the new constructor and a NULL check to the pre-existing ParseInteger.
reason: The const changes are style, and the ParseInteger NULL handling was not touched by this change.

defect: When the IN filter is pushed, Finalize now skips the min/max range filters, although the IN filter is an OptionalFilter used only for zonemap pruning, so probe-side scans lose their real filtering (performance regression).
reason: The 'continue' after a successful PushInFilter was added by this change, and the fix ('fix regression') removes it and pushes the min/max filters again.

defect: The fix detects hash-join IN filters inside a CONJUNCTION_AND (origin_is_hash_join) and moves the bound_ref construction into ExtractFilters.
reason: The repaired IN-filter handling came from the later bb3d8b6; this change's lines (BoundColumnRefExpression, direct row_ids scan) are only moved.

defect: The fix adds an origin_is_hash_join flag to InFilter and carries it through Copy and Equals.
reason: This is a feature addition for the index-scan logic, not a repair of the new InFilter's behaviour.

defect: The fix resets the output chunk between iterations so UNNEST(NULL) validity does not leak, and renames a shadowing variable.
reason: The change only replaced C-style casts with UnifiedVectorFormat::GetData; the UNNEST(NULL) behaviour was pre-existing.

defect: The fix sets rebind when a repeated parameter occurrence gets UNKNOWN type while its shared data already has a type.
reason: The old ExpressionBinder code had the same logic (second occurrence typed by GetReturnType without rebinding); the restructuring preserved an existing defect.

defect: The fix changes substring(a, 0, 3) to substring(a, 1, 3) in the CSE test.
reason: Both the change and the fix are test-only.

defect: The new early return compares threads.size() (size_t) with n - 1 (int32_t), a sign-compare warning that breaks the -Wall -Werror CI builds.
reason: The comparison was added by this change, CI builds with TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS, and the fix casts it to idx_t the same day.

defect: The new serialization check requires each child value's type to equal the declared child type exactly, so nested values whose child types differ only inside nested types (e.g. ANY deeper down) throw an InternalException.
reason: The fix relaxes the check to SerializeTypeMatches (same id, deep compare only for non-nested types) on the line this change added.

defect: The new information_schema.table_constraints view always builds the name from constraint_column_names[1], giving wrong names for multi-column or column-less CHECK constraints (e.g. a double underscore).
reason: The view was added by this change, and the fix corrects its naming expression.

defect: The FIRST() rewrite wraps every non-aggregate select expression, including group references, which breaks grouped queries such as TPC-H.
reason: The rewrite loop was added by this change, and the fix excludes GROUP_REF expressions.

defect: The fix parses parameter types with Parser::ParseLogicalType so list types such as VARCHAR[] are accepted in function descriptions.
reason: DefaultTypeGenerator::GetDefaultType was used before the change too; the change only added the ANY case, so list types failed before as well.

defect: The fix matches descriptions against the functions' real LogicalTypes instead of the types of the VARCHAR values holding the type names.
reason: ToLogicalTypeVector already took the Value's own type (always VARCHAR) before the change, and the multi-description path had the same comparison; the change copied the existing flaw.

defect: The fix adds typed parameters, a second variant for the list-of-formats overload, its description and its example to strptime.
reason: These are documentation and metadata strings, not code behaviour.

defect: The fix replaces the vector<char> buffer with std::string concatenation.
reason: The vector<char> code was correct (the result is copied by StringVector::AddString); the fix is a refactor.

defect: has_result is computed as return_type == StatementReturnType::NOTHING, the inverse of its meaning, so statements without results are chained and those with results are dropped.
reason: The inverted comparison was added by this change, and the fix compares against QUERY_RESULT.

defect: The fix gives each thread its own correct[i] slot and replaces rand() with a deterministic index.
reason: Both the change and the fix are confined to a test file.

defect: The fix casts the brace-initialiser values to idx_t to silence signed/unsigned conversion warnings for the optional_idx fields.
reason: The values are non-negative, so there is no wrong behaviour, and no default build flag makes this warning an error.

defect: The has_serialize detection added here uses the C++11 alias void_t, which does not SFINAE on GCC 4.8 (a CI compiler), and enable_if<has_serialize_v<T>()> relies on it, so the FormatSerialize overload is enabled for every type there.
reason: The trait and its use were introduced by this change, and the fix replaces them with an enable_if/is_same detection and has_serialize<T>::value.

defect: The fix rewrites has_serialize without void_t, as this change had already done for has_deserialize.
reason: The has_serialize lines were unchanged context in this change; the defect came from the earlier commit that introduced the trait.

defect: The fix adds an is_percentage check so row-count SYSTEM samples are not pushed down as a sample rate.
reason: The change was a pure reformat; the missing check was already there.

defect: state.dictionary.Insert<true>(src_value) calls a member template on a dependent type without the 'template' disambiguator, which GCC and Clang reject.
reason: The explicit template argument was added by this change, and the fix adds the 'template' keyword to fix the compiler error.

defect: The fix always computes types_to_write with GetTypesToCopy instead of falling back to op.types when no_partition_columns is false.
reason: types_to_write is only read when no_partition_columns is true, so the op.types branch was never used and the fix is a cleanup.

defect: The fix makes the || operator return NULL for a NULL list operand while list_concat keeps ignoring NULLs.
reason: The || operator already used the NULL-ignoring ListConcatFun before this change; the moved ListConcatFunction kept the same semantics.

defect: The fix makes StructColumnReader::GroupRowsAvailable skip children that are structs containing only lists or maps.
reason: The same GroupRowsAvailable logic already existed in struct_column_reader.hpp; the change only moved it into the .cpp.

defect: found_strings stores string_t values pointing into the input chunk, which are freed after Sink returns, so later lookups read dangling memory.
reason: The deduplication set was added by this change, and the fix inserts the copy owned by the result vector instead.
